answer: To resist Sybil attacks, the network routes coordination trust along a trellis of verified interactions while splitting identity verification through a cryptographic prism that isolates fraudulent behavior. An agent must burn native stake per identity under superlinear cost scaling where minting n identities incurs a cost scaling as O(n^2), rendering mass clone creation economically ruinous. Any malicious burst disperses like a zephyr against non-linear friction, enforcing total economic containment.
